text: {"label": "Employment and Services for Disabled Adults","definition": "Vocational skill training, job preference and performance assessment, supported employment outcomes, staff support, and quality of life for adolescents and adults with intellectual disabilities, developmental disabilities, or autism.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centres on adulthood, work, and adult service settings, rather than challenging behavior assessment and treatment, school-based academic instruction, or communication systems for people with developmental disabilities."}
